reason: B offers the stronger, more testable extension: W–P bonding and reduced atomic mobility are supported by prior P-containing metallic-glass data showing increased crystallization-onset temperatures, and the composition series provides a clear falsification route. Although its experiment should also test ~3000 K/s cooling and W-induced intermetallic formation, A is comparatively generic, unsupported, and does not establish that adding B to an already P-rich alloy would avoid boride crystallization.
